user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF yunmi_water_purifier.tds_in() <= 66 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() yunmi_water_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
